quotes.text: The work is not done until the board says it is done.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: If you cannot draw the problem on a whiteboard, you are not ready to schedule it.
quotes.author: Jensen Huang

quotes.text: Day 1 teams update the board before they update the narrative.
quotes.author: Jeff Bezos

quotes.text: 10x clearer ownership beats 10% more status meetings.
quotes.author: Larry Page

quotes.text: Write the decision. Oral handoffs do not survive the weekend.
quotes.author: Tobi Lütke

quotes.text: Play long-term games with honest dates.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Real artists ship — and then they open the next task.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: A bad plan with a single owner beats a perfect plan with none.
quotes.author: Peter Thiel

quotes.text: Do not fool the board. It will fool you back on ship day.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: Quality is what you do when no one is watching the ticket.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.text: Invert risk: list what would make this late, then kill those first.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: Delete the step that exists only to make someone feel busy.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: Peacetime is when you clear the overdue list so wartime is survivable.
quotes.author: Jensen Huang

quotes.text: Earn trust with a board that matches reality by Friday afternoon.
quotes.author: Jeff Bezos

quotes.text: Focus on the user of the task — the next person who depends on it.
quotes.author: Larry Page

quotes.text: Default to shipping a smaller slice that is actually finished.
quotes.author: Tobi Lütke

quotes.text: Specific knowledge is the hard problem only your team can close this week.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Say no to a thousand tickets so the great one ships.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Zero to one on a project: one clear owner, one definition of done.
quotes.author: Peter Thiel

quotes.text: What you cannot create, you do not yet understand — start with a small working piece.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: Nothing is particularly hard if you divide it into owned tasks with dates.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.text: Avoid the big error: celebrating motion while the critical path is red.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: Automate the report after the process is honest — not before.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: Speed of light on exceptions. Everything else can queue.
quotes.author: Jensen Huang

quotes.text: Two-way door: reassign, re-date, move on. One-way door: quality sign-off — go slow.

quotes.text: Moonshots still need a due date on the first milestone.
quotes.author: Larry Page

quotes.text: Craft compounds: leave every closed task easier for the next person to audit.
quotes.author: Tobi Lütke

quotes.text: Impatience with blocked tasks. Patience with compound skill.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Stay hungry for the next clear board. Stay foolish enough to ship this week.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: The secret is often the overdue item nobody wants to name in the meeting.
quotes.author: Peter Thiel
